name: Bathsheba
role: Wife of Uriah, then of David; mother of Solomon
whenBasis: In David's reign, ≈1010–970 BC, counted back from Solomon as Thiele and most chronologies do.
summary: Daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah the Hittite. David saw her bathing from his roof, sent for her and slept with her; she conceived, and after Uriah's death became David's wife. Their first son died. She bore Solomon, and in David's old age, with Nathan, secured the throne for him against Adonijah. As queen mother she brought Adonijah's request to Solomon.
body: The text tells the first episode from David's side: he sees, sends, takes. Her only words are three: “I am pregnant.” She mourns for Uriah.

Years later she goes in to the old king and reminds him of his oath that Solomon would reign. Solomon rises to meet her, bows, and sets a throne for her at his right hand; but her request that Adonijah be given Abishag leads to Adonijah's death. Matthew names her, without her name, as the wife of Uriah.

moments.text: A throne at Solomon's right hand
